header: What maintenance teams run on Vertex Supply
subheadline: Six functions that cover the day, from the first call to the invoice. Every plan has all six.

feature_items.title: Scheduling and routing
feature_items.description: Assign jobs by skill, certificate and drive time. See what a change costs the rest of the day before you make it.

feature_items.title: Technician app
feature_items.description: Job sheets, checklists, photos and signatures on iOS and Android. Seven days of data stay on the phone for sites without signal.

feature_items.title: Asset register
feature_items.description: Serial numbers, warranty dates and full service history for each unit, opened from a QR label on the equipment.

feature_items.title: Parts and van stock
feature_items.description: Stock is counted at every job close, with reorder points per van. You see a warning when a promised part is three days away.

feature_items.title: SLA and contract tracking
feature_items.description: Response windows per contract, breach warnings 30 minutes ahead and an audit trail you can show your customer as it is.

feature_items.title: Reporting
feature_items.description: First-time fix rate, travel time and contract profit, exported weekly to your reporting tools or a spreadsheet.
